notes.title: 1/16 Update
notes.content: Fixed a problem with some furniture that caused cats to be buried in the furniture.

notes.title: 1/13Update
notes.content:
Fixed bugs and unexpected behavior.
Fixed a bug in which the description of the currently equipped hair ornament was not changed when changing the hair ornament.
Fixed a bug that caused hair ornaments to be initialized after loading.
Fixed a bug that caused some extreme shortcuts.
